rows.grounds: present participle of kliś in nominative plural masculine, describing the subject
instrumental singular of tapas, indicating the means of suffering
accusative singular object governed by vinā
third person plural active present of root yā

items.question: Can practitioners attain liberation through austerity alone when knowledge is absent?
premises: Suffering practitioners do not attain liberation.
items.inference: Austerity alone cannot yield liberation; knowledge is required.
uncertainties: Whether te refers to all practitioners or only a subset.
items.plain_english: Those who suffer through austerity without knowledge do not attain liberation.
